title: I bless Your Name
lyrics_original: Paul and Silas prayed that night
And in their pain began to sing
I give You honor, give You praise
You are the Life, the Truth, the Way
You're in a prison in your mind
We give You honor, give You praise
You are the Life, the Truth, the Way
You are the Life, the Truth, the Way

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే మధ్యరాత్రివేళ పౌలును సీలయు దేవునికి ప్రార్థించుచు కీర్తనలు పాడుచునుండిరి; ఖయిదీలు వినుచుండిరి. అప్పుడు అకస్మాత్తుగా మహా భూకంపము కలిగెను, చెరసాల పునాదులు అదరెను, వెంటనే తలుపులన్నియు తెరచుకొనెను, అందరి బంధకములు ఊడెను.
bible_verses.english: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them. Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

bible_verses.telugu: నేనెల్లప్పుడు యెహోవాను సన్నుతించెదను. నిత్యము ఆయన కీర్తి నా నోట నుండును.
bible_verses.english: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

bible_verses.telugu: కాబట్టి  ఆయనద్వారా మనము దేవునికి ఎల్లప్పుడును స్తుతియాగము చేయుదము, అనగా ఆయన నామమును ఒప్పుకొనుచు, జిహ్వాఫలము అర్పించుదము.
bible_verses.english: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise—the fruit of lips that openly profess his name.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I choose to bless Your name today, even in the middle of life's struggles and uncertainty. You are my Way, my Truth, and my Life, and my heart longs to give You the praise You deserve. Break every chain of fear or doubt in my life as I fix my eyes on You. May my continuous worship be a sweet sacrifice that honors You in every season. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I choose to bless Your name today, even in the middle of life's struggles and uncertainty. You are my Way, my Truth, and my Life, and my heart longs to give You the praise You deserve. Break every chain of fear or doubt in my life as I fix my eyes on You. May my continuous worship be a sweet sacrifice that honors You in every season. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When Paul and Silas were bound in a dark prison cell, they chose praise over despair. Their sacrifice of worship opened heaven and broke physical and spiritual chains. No matter what trials or heavy burdens you are carrying today, blessing God’s name shifts our focus from our painful circumstances to His unchanging goodness. As we lift our voices to declare that Jesus is the Way, the Truth, and the Life, our hearts find true freedom in His presence.
